answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in tundra, checked in delta, and glacier reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 3 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4356 identities would post 1236 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
